rice.notes: Yield varies significantly between Kharif (Kuruvai) and Rabi (Samba) seasons.

maize.notes: Highly dependent on hybrid seed varieties and irrigation.

sugarcane.notes: Water-intensive. Yields depend heavily on monsoon and irrigation availability.

cotton.notes: Prone to pest attacks (bollworm). Bt cotton is widely used.

groundnut.notes: Rainfed crops generally yield lower than irrigated ones.

banana.notes: Requires consistent soil moisture and protection from heavy winds.

tomato.notes: Susceptible to heat stress during flowering.

onion.notes: Requires well-drained soils; sensitive to waterlogging.
